title: cynorkis lilacina subsp. curvicalcar
intro: Cynorkis lilacina subsp. curvicalcar, commonly known as the orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Cynorkis lilacina subsp. curvicalcar include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
